description: This file is a PHP class that initializes customer-related data during the startup process of the OpenCart e-commerce system. It sets the customer object in the registry and determines the customer group ID based on session data or login status.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: A controller class responsible for initializing customer session and group data during application startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer object, and sets the customer group ID in the configuration based on session data or login status.
